explicit_paths.entry: default old on_message/on_regex/on_startswith and other non-command matcher handlers
explicit_paths.reason: A source inventory confirms seven default matcher registrations here: five regex, one message, and one notice matcher. Their effects are mixed: work claim now atomically commits user_cd, the status=2 work_offer_snapshots projection, the selected work_active_snapshots payload and its receipt; settlement prefers a read-only feature active snapshot, with the legacy read path retained only when no active snapshot is available. Expiration now uses WorkRefreshApplication.mark_offer_expired -> WorkRefreshSqlRepository.mark_offer_expired to compare-and-set the database snapshot; savef(sync_snapshot=False) afterward writes only the JSON file projection. Refresh and claim also retain JSON projections, so the compatibility boundary is still open. The bank regex handler still owns parsing, validation, orchestration, and reply mapping even though mutations call feature applications. Media parsing and fallback retain legacy callbacks; group lifecycle notices remain a separate old event path. Keep the family blocked until every handler and remaining projection has a closed owner; do not add members automatically, and put out-of-scope discoveries in backlog for explicit review.
